title: The owner-feedback Stop check accepts a process-only ruling whose home is roadmap/rulings
why: Possible false alarm (coordinator 12:05 CST Nov 13): the check refused a lane's inbox item for R67 (drain-first-hold) because the ruling lives on origin/roadmap, not main. R67 orders work and rules no behaviour of a lane's code, so no decision record on main is needed.
note: Todo. Triage judgement: a ruling file marked process-only on roadmap counts as a home for a lane inbox item; a ruling that rules behaviour still needs a decision record on main. Red first on R67; verify the check's own record of the false alarm first (verification-cry-wolf-guard-is-spent).
